subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: Borman was joined on the mission by two other astronauts.
Borman was joinned on the mission by two other astronaots.
Borman was joined on the mision by two other astronaots.
Borman was joined on the missoin by two other astronaots.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"joined"** means to come into the company of others or to become a member of a group. (शामिल होना)

 
 
• **Example: **She **joined **the team last year and has been a great asset ever since.
 
 
 
• **"Astronauts"** refers to people who are trained to travel in a spacecraft. (अंतरिक्ष यात्री)
 
 
• **Example: **The** astronauts** prepared for months before embarking on their space mission.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Joinned** (जॉइन्ड): Incorrect spelling of 'joined'.

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: She joinned the team last year. Correct: She joined the team last year.
 
 
 
• **Astronaots** (एस्ट्रोनॉट्स): Incorrect spelling of 'astronauts'.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: The astronaots were ready for their mission. Correct: The astronauts were ready for their mission.
 
 
 
• **Mision** (मिशन): Incorrect spelling of 'mission'.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: The mision was a success. Correct: The mission was a success.
 
 
 
• **Missoin** (मिस्सोइन): Incorrect spelling of 'mission'.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: The missoin was difficult. Correct: The mission was difficult.
